verdicts.reason: Both break the reading order the same way. Steps run 02, 03, 01, with 02 sitting above the headline. The step copy is shrunk to tiny text you can't read, and the BLOOM logo has fallen to the middle of the layout instead of leading. A at least keeps BLOOM next to the subtitle and leaves sensible side margins. B wedges step 03 between the logo and the subtitle, pushes the headline almost to the canvas edges, and stretches the CTA nearly full-width, so it feels more cramped.
